summary: A report from a joint W3C and IETF planning group that clarifies how URIs, URLs and URNs relate to one another and how URI schemes and URN namespaces get registered. It also lists open issues and makes recommendations. It is informational, not a specification.

eli5.summary: People argued over whether web addresses and permanent names were different things. This report explains how the words fit together, like clarifying that every street address is a kind of location.

questions: what is the difference between url and urn
